<subject>Status Update Request</subject>
<body>
Dear Mr. Thompson,

Greenfield Energy Solutions, acting on behalf of the Midlands Water Authority, will soon be inviting bids for gas supply. We are currently considering limited gas purchases and wish to establish a Gas Interchange Service Agreement (GISA) promptly. 

We would appreciate a brief update regarding the status of the GISA contract between your firm and the Midlands Water Authority. Should your legal team have any queries or require further clarification, please feel free to reach out to James Carter at Greenfield Energy Solutions on 0141 555 6723.

To assist with any credit-related matters, the Authority is in the process of compiling a comprehensive credit package, which we will provide to you once finalized.

Please do not hesitate to contact us if you require any further information.

Kind regards,  
Samantha Lane  
Contract Administration  
Greenfield Energy Solutions  
0141 555 6723  
</body>
